This is the first release with ZangbandTK, a second way to play the game.
It's modelled on ZangbandTk from the late 1990s: the map in one window, your
character, your gear, your spell books and the shops in windows of their own,
and a menu bar with every command on it, so you don't have to know the keys.
It runs on the Mac, Windows and Linux.

It's the same game as Zangband, built from the same source, and the two share
your characters. Take whichever you prefer, or both.

## Which download do I want?

| You have | ZangbandTK | Zangband |
|---|---|---|
| A Mac with Apple Silicon (M1 or later) | `ZangbandTK-3.138.0-osx-tk.dmg` | `Zangband-3.138.0-osx.dmg` |
| A Mac with an Intel processor | no build, sorry | `Zangband-3.138.0-osx-intel.dmg` |
| Windows, 64-bit | `ZangbandTK-3.138.0-win64-tk.zip` | `Zangband-3.138.0-win64.zip` |
| Windows, 32-bit | | `Zangband-3.138.0-win32.zip` |
| Linux, x86-64 | `ZangbandTK-3.138.0-linux64-tk.AppImage` | `Zangband-3.138.0-linux64.AppImage` |
| Linux, 64-bit ARM | `ZangbandTK-3.138.0-linux64-tk-arm.AppImage` | `Zangband-3.138.0-linux64-arm.AppImage` |

Zangband also comes as a terminal build for the Mac
(`-osx-terminal.tar.gz`, `-osx-terminal-intel.tar.gz`) and for Linux
(`-linux64-terminal.tar.gz`, and `-linux64-terminal-arm.tar.gz` for ARM), for
DOS (`-dos.zip`) and for the Nintendo DS and
3DS (`-nintendo.zip`). `ZangbandTK-3.138.0.tar.gz` is the source for all of
them.

The Linux downloads run on glibc 2.27 or newer: Ubuntu 18.04, Debian 10,
RHEL 8 and anything after them.

The ARM files were added after the rest, built from the same 3.138.0 source.
They are for a Raspberry Pi with a 64-bit system, an ARM laptop or server, or
Linux in a virtual machine on an Apple Silicon Mac: `uname -m` says `aarch64`.

## If you played 3.121.0 or earlier on a Mac

The names have swapped. Up to 3.128.0 the Mac application was called
ZangbandTK.app, although it had no Tk in it. It's Zangband.app now, and the
name ZangbandTK belongs to the new application.

So if you have an old ZangbandTK.app in Applications, it's Zangband under its
old name. Look before you let the Finder replace it with the new one, because
that swaps one game for the other. Your characters are safe either way: they
live in `Documents/ZangbandTK` in your home folder, which neither application
touches when it's replaced, and that folder kept its name for exactly this
reason.

## Opening it the first time

Neither application is signed with a paid developer certificate, so your
computer will stop the first launch.

- On a Mac, macOS says it can't verify the application. Try to open it once,
  click *Done*, then open System Settings, Privacy & Security, and click
  *Open Anyway* near the bottom.
- On Windows, SmartScreen stops it. Click *More info*, then *Run anyway*.
- On Linux, make the AppImage executable with `chmod +x` and run it.

The [download page](https://zangbandtk.com/download.html) has the details,
and the Mac and Windows downloads have a README that says the same.

## What's new since 3.121.0

- ZangbandTK itself: the Character window, with a Flags page
  that shows your resistances and abilities and what gives you each one. The Items
  window, with a paper doll you can drag gear onto. A Knowledge browser, the
  Spell Book, the shops, a Birth window that makes a character without the text
  screens, a portrait for every race and class, the Tomb window and the Hall of
  Fame. F1 in any window opens the manual at the page for it. On Windows and
  Linux it has sound and music too.
- Statues and the Statue Store, and the magical figurine with its own
  Figurine Store, the last of Zangband's ways to get a pet.
- Two of Zangband's ironman options, *stores are permanently closed* and
  *always create unusually small levels*, as birth options.
- Warriors and Paladins burn rare spellbooks for experience, as in Zangband.
- Nightmare mode is finished, with four additions of our own beyond
  Zangband's.
- Shuffle, Wraithform, Omnicide, Explosive Rune, nine other realm spells and
  five mutations did nothing, and now work.
- Among the fixes: a crash at great depth, pets that broke your runes, a
  bounty that forgot its target when saved, and the Scroll of Mundanity
  breaking your pack.
- The Linux downloads start on older distributions, needing glibc 2.27
  instead of 2.35.

The [release log](https://zangbandtk.com/releases.html) has the rest.

## Known gaps

- ZangbandTK is new. On the Mac it has been played a good deal. On Windows and
  Linux it's built, tested by script on every change and checked to start from
  its own download, but nobody has played a game through on either yet. If
  something goes wrong, please
  [open an issue](https://github.com/z88kat/ZangbandTK/issues).
- There is no Intel Mac build of ZangbandTK, and there won't be one.
- In ZangbandTK the mouse does nothing on the map itself yet, and item
  ignoring and auto-inscription still use the game's text screens.
- A character saved before 3.73.0 loads with some of what it knew about
  object kinds attached to the wrong ones, because kinds were added since and
  that knowledge was saved by position. Characters saved from 3.73.0 on are
  fine.
